name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Baseball Display Holder
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a sturdy, decorative, and durable display solution for baseball keepsakes.
    - Designed with a 2-layer wooden construction, each layer 5mm thick, that creates depth, dimension, and a more eye-catching finished look.
    - Includes a 5mm thick wooden base for secure placement on flat surfaces.
    - Available with different stand structures depending on the selected design:
             +) 5 mm BASE SLOT FOR 1-LAYER INSERT AREA
             +) 10 mm BASE SLOT FOR 1-LAYER INSERT AREA

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Product size: 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for vibrant colors and sharp details.
    - Layer 1 – 2-sided printing.
    - Layer 2 – 1-sided printing.
    - Base – 2-sided printing.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a baseball display holder and a personalized decorative keepsake.
    - Designed to hold and showcase a baseball in a stylish and meaningful display format.
    - Suitable for desks, shelves, sports rooms, bedrooms, offices, trophy areas, and display cabinets.
    - Perfect for commemorating memorable games, team achievements, coach appreciation, family baseball moments, and player keepsakes.
    - The wooden stand provides stable support for tabletop display while the custom design adds a unique personal touch.
    - Great for everyday display, sports décor, and collectible presentation.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for dads, coaches, baseball players, teammates, family members, and sports lovers.
    - Perfect for Father’s Day, coach appreciation gifts, birthdays, team celebrations, senior night, tournaments, and special milestones.
    - Ideal for baseball-themed décor, sports memorabilia displays, and custom keepsake gifts.
    - A thoughtful gift for anyone who wants to preserve a baseball memory in a decorative and personal way.
    - Great for home décor, office décor, sports room display, and collectible presentation.
    - Adds a sporty, heartfelt, and memorable touch to any space🎁

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Baseball Display Holder

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
